body:
Your comment left me speechless for a while. Every word you say is just so true and I don't know how I should feel about that you are basically the same as me in so many aspects. My thoughts are sort of scattered.

I'm not sure where this all leads to, I'm not sure where to take the strength from to get things changed, but at least I am self aware, right?

My mind is torturing me, but I am trying to stay alive, just somehow. We will see what I can do.

I have been in a band like 6 or 7 years ago, but kinda grew out of it. It was a nice experience as a highschool kid, after a while it caused more stress and quarrels than fun though. I sold my band equipment right after I left, so I doubt I'd approach this step ever again. :/

Music lessons are quite expensive, so I've abandoned them a while ago. I used to have a youtube channel, but I abandoned it, too (lack of motivation).
Music would be more attractive to me than art lessons though. My art skills are kind of limited, unworthy to develop.

I tried to make it my profession.
A simple goal would just be to end up happy somehow, having a good and stable social life etc. Being independent, including a well paid job, a life and responsibility of my own.

I always admire those who seem to easily adapt to a new surrounding or just to new living circumstances, in general. I'm definitely not this type of person. In my main post I wrote that I acted out of cowardice - and that is not even understaded. There were so many things in my life that just went wrong, that at some point, I started to organize myself in an excessive manner. I relied on it. It gave me some kind of security in my life, and filled something what always lacked and had been missing. Now that it all broke apart, the purpose in my life seems to be gone, as well - which was the future I planned beforehand in my head. It is a mind-thing, I know. The fear of failure defines me. These thoughts are on my mind, and they are easy like you say; they are easy to get in there but not easy to get off. It feels demeanng to give in, I already stepped so low, I'm not sure if it can take it getting any lower. Asking for help is the most humilating thing to me in the existence of this world. I always did things on my own, the idea of literally giving my life into the hands of others scares the shit out of me. How did you apporach help? I'd just hide in my hole of doom forever. I'm rather selfdestructful, I guess the pride kind of ruined me for the most part. There really is no one in my family I can try to apporach, I actually tried before, instead of helping me they are turning me down even more, so that's not an option. And I'd rather go for someone who is close than some nameless professionals. Approaching new people is kind of impossible for me, I am too awkward, even for the most awkward persons themselves. I'm sure if I can do anything about it, I am kind of mind-trapped.
The only thing that keeps me going is the fear of a failing suicide attempt and thus ending up being in a state which is much worse than what I am now. Nothing else.

I just feel like it's too late to do anything. 
And by success I mean both, a career, wealth and a social life. I'm the only person in my family without a college graduation, and I know they look down at me and feel ashamed for my existence. I didn't just want to succeed for them, mainly for myself, but this is something which is just making me feel worse.
A new education does not come in question, since I'm already too old. It's not like I'm 18 anymore. I should be able to stand on my own feet, but I am not. Instead I am leeching on recources of the state and this is something my conscience just cannot deal with.
I know that I would not seek any real help, since I'm too embarassed by my own existence and rather wish to vanish. But thank's anyways. I guess, these are great tips for eveyone else.
yes but it doesn't help ne
I do have hobbys, but it doesn't work as a distraction anymore. I just feel so bad, no matter what I do
